name: Studio
insp: film title sequences and photo-led studio sites
rec: The recommended design: it keeps Studio's calm film look and brings in the best moments from the other eleven concepts, each re-dressed in that look, so it shows the real people, the real dates and the real office while staying smooth on phones.
desc: Shot like a film, and the most complete of the twelve. Letterbox bars slide open on the real office photos, the slideshow steps back into the welcome, and the services turn as pages of a deep blue production book. The promises play as title cards, the three leaders pass on a film strip, a curtain parts onto the award, and a departures board counts down to the next IRD date above the tax year running past as film frames.
fx: Title sequence: letterbox bars slide open, the headline rises line by line and the welcome lights up word by word
The services as a production book whose pages turn as you scroll, one page at a time with arrows on phones
A departures board counts down live to the next standard IRD date on split-flap digits
The tax year runs past as film frames while a line draws itself, with today marked
Ranjana, Varun and Eshan pass on a sideways film strip before the team rolls past as credits
A theatre curtain parts onto the award before the photo opens through a shutter
Tax terms stream past like end-credit type and lean with your scroll speed
Embossed buttons and a map of Manukau Road where the pin drops onto 620
